annotations.title: Turn the automatic HubSpot lead sync on or off

description: Switch the AUTOMATIC HubSpot lead sync on or off for this brand: enabled, everyMinutes (a whole number from 15 to 1440; default 60 — anything outside that is refused, not clamped), optional platforms (meta, linkedin, tiktok, x, snapchat, chatgpt, reddit; default every connected one). Each run is sync_leads_to_hubspot reading from the last successful run, so a new lead reaches the CRM within minutes and nothing is ever created twice. If HubSpot is disconnected a run records that and the schedule backs off to once a day — no emails. runNow:true runs the first one straight away. Answers with the stored setting and the armed run, read back. Free. Needs HubSpot connected to switch on.

enabled.description: true turns the automatic lead sync on; false turns it off

runNow.description: true = run the first sync immediately

name: set_hubspot_lead_sync
